requirement: Select at most one valid input and give lower indices priority
rationale: The upstream programs drive arbiters instantiated in the selected CPU. The added floating-point program aligns load and conversion responses so that both inputs of a two-input execution-response arbiter are valid in the same cycle.

requirement: Assert an input's ready when the output is ready and no lower-index input is valid
rationale: The selected memory and execution programs produce ready-valid traffic. The added floating-point program also exposes an incorrect selected response in the architectural register trace without relying on internal event values for the verdict.

requirement: Assert the output valid signal whenever an input request is valid
rationale: Compare retired instructions and architectural updates against Spike.
